jobs.description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

jobs.title: People & Production Manager - Material & Delivery
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Material & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application

This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-17.  Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Behaviour Change interventions (Part-Time, Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
The Danish Centre for Motivation and Behaviour Science (DRIVEN), Research
Unit for Behaviour Science, Motivation and Health (STRIVE) at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics (IOB), invites applications for a fixed-term, part-time (80%) postdoc position commencing as soon as possible and ending 30 September 2028.

The position is established in connection with the joint project “mPADapp - Digital Decision Support for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD)” between DRIVEN (SDU), the Institute of Clinical Medicine (IMK) at Aarhus University and the Vascular Research Unit at Viborg Regional Hospital.

About the project

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) is a major vascular health issue affecting quality of life, mobility, and survival. The mPADapp project aims to improve adherence to clinical guidelines for PAD treatment via an interactive decision support tool. The tool will be integrated into a mobile app for patients and into healthcare providers’ systems, to enhance understanding, motivation, and behaviour change around preventive treatments (e.g. medication adherence, smoking cessation, physical activity etc.). A key component is the development of the app’s behavioural intervention design, grounded in evidence on mechanisms of successful behaviour change.

About the job

The postdoc is expected to manage the design and refinement of an app for telerehabilitation. The role will focus on identifying and integrating effective behaviour change techniques (BCTs), user experience/user-centered design, digital engagement, and mechanisms of motivation, self-regulation, habit formation, and sustained adherence.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team (clinicians, epidemiologists, app developers, AI-scientists, patient representatives) to co-design the app features that promote sustained behaviour change

  • Review and apply theoretical frameworks and empirical evidence on behaviour change mechanisms (motivation, self-efficacy, intention formation, cues/triggers, habit formation, feedback loops, rewards etc.)

  • Identify BCTs appropriate for PAD patients, particularly those who may have low health literacy, low motivation, sociocultural or economic vulnerabilities

  • Collect and analyse qualitative and quantitative studies (usability testing, field pilots, interviews, survey, digital usage data) to test usability, acceptability, engagement, and mechanisms

  • Contribute to app iteration, interface design, content generation (e.g. messaging, reminders, motivational feedback) ensuring alignment with evidence-based BCTs and self-determination theory

  • Prepare high-quality publications, present at conferences and ensure that findings inform clinical integration and implementation

For information on postdoc positions at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics in general, please click.

Qualifications

  • A completed PhD or equivalent research experience at PhD level in psychology, behaviour science, public health, digital health, or related field, with demonstrated experience in behaviour change/intervention science

  • Strong knowledge of behaviour change theories and frameworks (e.g. Self-Determination Theory, COM-B, Behaviour Change Wheel, Health Action Process Approach etc.)

  • Experience with digital health interventions or mobile app behaviour support (design and evaluation)

  • Strong collaboration skills, able to work in interdisciplinary teams including clinicians, software developers, and health economists

  • Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English (written and oral)

We offer

  • A stimulating interdisciplinary research environment, with strong ties to vascular surgery, epidemiology, digital health, and user involvement

  • Resources for user panels/patient involvement, usability labs, and collaboration with app developers

  • Opportunities for publication, networking, and professional development

Further information and contact:

For more information about the position and the department, please contact Professor Nikos Ntoumanis, Head of Centre, Tel: (+45) 6550 4525, e-mail: nntoumanis@health.sdu.dk or Jens Troelsen, Head of Department, Tel: (+45) 6550 3493, e-mail: jtroelsen@health.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for the period mentioned above. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years in total at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

The shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Employment as a postdoctoral researcher requires a PhD degree or academic qualifications at PhD level.  

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree or equivalent aacademic qualifications at PhD level (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to 4 of the most relevant publications. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication 

  • Reference letters/references may also be included 

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is 25 October 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics

The Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics adheres to SDU's strategy and values.  Our department is recognized for our interdisciplinary research. The scientific, technical and administrative staff support this through active participation in the department's professional and social life. We prefer candidates with the ambition to make mutual working relationships thrive.

About The Faculty of Health Sciences

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

About Us

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Passenger car auto mechanic
jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems).

  • Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

  • Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors. No work on the high-voltage battery is required.

  • Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

  • Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

  • Are a trained passenger car mechanic

  • Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

  • Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

  • Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

  • Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

  • Hold a category B driving licence

  • Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

  • Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

  • Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

  • To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

  • An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

  • Ongoing training and good development opportunities

  • A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

  • Attractive terms of employment

  • A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

jobs.title: Thesis project: Pallet perception through deep learning and sensor fusion
jobs.description:
Develop methods using deep learning models to improve the current pallet perception system, with a focus on fusing model outputs with data from other sensors. The main focus will be on general pallet identification and localization.

In your Master Thesis at Toyota, you will work on:

A modern sensor system featuring:

    2D RGB camera
    Time-of-Flight (ToF) 3D camera
    Correlation between pixels from the RGB camera and points in the 3D point cloud from the ToF camera
    NVIDIA chip in an embedded environment (GPU) for data processing

Tasks include:

    Training and evaluation of deep learning (DL) models using different methodologies
    Algorithm development for data fusion
    Evaluation using real-world data and comparison with training results from a synthetic environment

At Toyota, we work with innovative technologies to develop our autonomous trucks. The thesis project will investigate training methodologies, model architecture, and the selection of suitable model outputs that can be effectively combined with point cloud data to accurately localize a pallet in relation to the camera position. The training data will be generated in synthetic environments, which will be provided as part of the project. Therefore, the gap between synthetic and real-world data will also need to be considered when evaluating the results. The thesis project will be carried out in close collaboration with one of Toyota's teams specializing in machine learning development.

SCOPE
Master thesis 30 hp, 1-2 students

Requirements
For this master thesis, we are looking for students with following education or equivalent:

    3D Computer vision
    Deep learning specialization / Machine Learning specialization

Who is Toyota Material Handling?
Toyota Material Handling is a global leader in material handling, and we are making significant investments to meet the needs of the future. At our site in Mjölby, 3,000 employees work across the entire material handling value chain, from development concepts to finished vehicles. Our product range spans from manual hand trucks to autonomous vehicles and innovative energy solutions.

At Toyota Material Handling, we strive to create a friendly, safe and forward-thinking workplace. Our culture is built on Toyota's core values, where respect and consideration guide us in our daily work. Our ambition is to strengthen our competitiveness by increasing diversity across the organization and embracing our differences.

Start
January 2027

Your application is individual. If you plan to do the master thesis together with another student, please specify name of that person. Latest date for application 2026-11-01.

Your application can be written in English or Swedish.

jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme vakituista vuokraamotyöntekijää vahvistamaan tiimiä Espoon toimipisteelle.

Asiakkaamme on rakennus- ja työmaakaluston vuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, joka palvelee rakennusalan ammattilaisia laajalla kone- ja laitevalikoimalla. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen kaluston parissa ja auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat ratkaisut erilaisiin rakennus-, remontti- ja maanrakennusprojekteihin.

Etsimme käytännönläheistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy koneiden, laitteiden ja asiakkaiden parissa. Työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja sisältävät sekä asiakaspalvelua että konkreettista tekemistä kaluston kanssa.

Työtehtäväsi:

Vuokraamotyöntekijänä vastaat monipuolisesti kaluston vuokrausprosessista ja asiakkaiden palvelusta. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden palvelu ja tarpeisiin sopivan kaluston kartoittaminen

- koneiden ja laitteiden luovutukset sekä vastaanotot

- kaluston tarkastus, järjestely ja käyttökunnosta huolehtiminen

- asiakkaiden opastus laitteiden turvalliseen käyttöön

- kuormaukset, purkamiset ja kaluston siirtely

- vuokrausjärjestelmän käyttö sekä muut päivittäiset vuokraamon tehtävät


Kalusto on erittäin monipuolinen sisältäen esimerkiksi pienkoneita, rakennustyökaluja, henkilönostimia, maanrakennuskoneita, työmaakalustoa sekä erilaisia erikoislaitteita.

Odotamme sinulta

Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- teknistä ymmärrystä tai kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- asiakaslähtöinen ja reipas työote

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tarttua erilaisiin tehtäviin

- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta käytännön tekemiseen

- halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä kaluston osaajaksi


Aikaisempi kokemus esimerkiksi rakennusalalta, koneiden parista, huollosta, logistiikasta tai teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

- monipuolisen työn rakennuskaluston ja koneiden parissa

- mahdollisuuden oppia laajasti erilaisesta ammattikalustosta

- vaihtelevan työn, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu ja käytännön tekeminen

- hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään

- mukavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden


Työ sijaitsee Espoossa.

Jos olet käytännönläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy koneiden, asiakkaiden ja vaihtelevien työpäivien parissa, tässä voi olla sinulle sopiva seuraava askel.

Jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään – haastattelemme sopivia hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: VIA Campus Silkeborg søger barselsvikar for campuspartner
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at skabe stærke fællesskaber og en meningsfuld hverdag for mennesker omkring dig? Er du skarp til at bringe mennesker sammen, knuse problemstillinger og omsætte ideer til handling? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler. VIA Campus Silkeborg søger en campuspartner til at arbejde med campusmiljø og brobygning. 

Som campuspartner er du en central figur i at skabe og vedligeholde stærke studiemiljøer og fællesskaber på Campus Silkeborg. Du skal være med til at understøtte det studiesociale miljø for studerende, have kontakt og netværk til lokale virksomheder og foreninger og være primær kontaktperson i campusanliggender for medarbejdere, studerende og interne såvel som eksterne samarbejdspartnere, når det handler om det strategiske tværgående arbejde på campus. Samt understøtte netværksarbejde med ungdomsuddannelser i Skanderborg, Silkeborg, Ikast-Brande og Herning Kommune.

Jobindholdet er meget alsidigt og kræver, at du kan se dig ind i en del skift i løbet af en arbejdsuge. Du kan være i gang med at udarbejde en sagsfremstilling, planlægge en proces, være tovholder for et brobygningsarrangement, hjælpe studerende med at planlægge en temadag og arbejde med synlighed på sociale medier.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

Som campuspartner vil du bl.a. skulle varetage følgende opgaver:

  • Understøtte studerende i arbejdet med udvikling af campusmiljøet - på to matrikler
  • Varetage administrative og understøttende opgaver for campusledelsen, herunder mødesupport, referater og opgaver relateret til campusbudget og regnskab
  • Være understøttende led mellem studenterforeninger samt mellem studenterforeninger og ledelser
  • Koordinere og facilitere campusarrangementer for studerende og ansatte (information, indbydelser, tilmelding og forplejning osv.)
  • Være understøttende kontaktperson i tværgående brobygningsaktiviteter 
  • Understøtte afvikling af arrangementer for campus
  • Kontakt til interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Fange de gode historier og få dem ud at leve. Varetage kommunikation på og om campus, bl.a. på sociale medier

Du vil indgå i netværk med campuspartnere fra de andre campusser i VIA.

Kvalifikationer

Vi søger en person med en udadvendt profil, der kan begå sig i en kompleks organisation, og som har en bred kompetenceprofil med stærke netværks-, event- og aktivitetskompetencer samt administrative kompetencer. Du skal være nysgerrig på mennesker, besidde relationskompetencer, have lyst til at understøtte opgaver, mod til at stå frem i forsamlinger og sætte pris på både udviklings- og driftsopgaver. Du skal have et drive og et gå-på-mod, også når tilslutning til aktiviteter ikke kommer af sig selv.

Din baggrund kan være en professionsbacheloruddannelse, en kandidatuddannelse eller noget helt tredje.

Om os

Campus Silkeborg har ca. 1.200 studerende, på to forskellige adresser i Silkeborg og Ikast. Vi har uddannelse til lærer, pædagog, sygeplejerske samt efter-/videreuddannelsesaktiviteter.  Vi deler mange fælles faciliteter, fx kantine, faglokaler, makerspace, bibliotek og studenterhus, hvilket giver gode muligheder for et spændende og tværfagligt studiemiljø.

Yderligere information

For spørgsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte en af de to campusledere:

Anja Madsen Kvols mail: ankv@via.dk eller telefon 87553102

Kristine Buus Johansen mail: krbj@via.dk eller telefon 87553745

I stillingen som campuspartner vil du have reference til Anja Madsen Kvols.

Ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 30 timer ugentligt fra den 16. november 2026 til den 31. oktober 2027

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten, Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO samt organisationsaftalen for kontorfunktionærer (HK),eller anden relevant overenskomst.

Hovedarbejdssted er Campus Silkeborg, Nattergalevej 1, 8600 Silkeborg, men med faste arbejdsdage på Pædagoguddannelsen Ikast, og der må forventes aktiviteter i hele Region Midtjylland. Derfor er kørekort en forudsætning, og aftenarbejde må forventes.

Lyder dette som noget for dig, så send en målrettet og motiveret ansøgning vedlagt relevante bilag senest den 5. oktober.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt fredag i uge 41.

VI er VIA  
VIA er en af Danmarks største uddannelsesinstitutioner med lokationer overalt i Region Midtjylland. Vi uddanner og efteruddanner bl.a. lærere, sygeplejersker, ingeniører, designere og mange flere. Vi udvikler uddannelser i tæt samarbejde med praksis. Vi er en arbejdsplads med fleksibilitet, frihed og gode muligheder for udvikling. Hvis du er nysgerrig på, hvordan det er at arbejde i VIA, kan du læse nogle af vores fortællinger her.   

I VIA værdsætter vi kompetence og talent i alle former. Vi tror på styrken i diversitet og byder alle velkomne, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet eller baggrund. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen og blive en del af et inkluderende fællesskab.  

Læs mere om VIA University College på http://www.via.dk/

jobs.title: Gold Controller
jobs.description:
How does a role in the fast-growing precious metals industry sound, with the opportunity to learn a completely new profession?

We are now looking for energetic and motivated Gold controllers to join Gold Fleet AB . Previous experience in precious metals is not required, as we will provide you with comprehensive training for the role and the tools and methods used in the work.

What will you be doing?

As a Gold Controller, you will learn how to assess gold and other precious metals using the tools and methods provided by the company. Accuracy and attention to detail are important in this role, but you do not need to know everything from day one. We will provide you with thorough training and support.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Assessing gold and other precious metals using the tools and methods provided by the company
    Weighing, testing, and determining the value of precious metals
    Supporting the controller team in daily operations and quality assurance
    Following company procedures, safety guidelines, and ethical standards
    Collaborating with different teams and stakeholders
    Supporting the smooth handling and processing of purchased precious metals

What are we looking for?

    An energetic and positive approach to work
    A proactive attitude and willingness to take initiative
    Accuracy and strong attention to detail
    A genuine interest in learning and developing your skills
    Good organizational skills
    The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Previous experience is a plus, not a requirement

You do not need previous experience in gold or precious metals appraisal to succeed in this role.

However, previous experience with jewelry, precious metals, goldsmithing or other work requiring accuracy and attention to detail is considered an advantage. Familiarity with weighing and testing equipment or different appraisal methods is also beneficial.

Most importantly, we value your motivation, initiative, and willingness to learn.

What do we offer?

    Comprehensive training for the role – you do not need to be an expert when you join us
    The opportunity to learn and develop expertise in a unique and interesting industry
    A supportive and relaxed team around you
    A varied role where you can continuously develop your skills
    The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing international business
    Meaningful work where your accuracy and contribution make a real difference

Interested?

Send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications already during the application period and will move forward quickly with suitable candidates.

Join our growing team – we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Business Controller, Vianor
jobs.description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.
- High level of integrity, ownership and attention to detail, combined with the ability to operate independently and drive improvement across processes, tools and ways of working.
- Good command of modern finance systems, reporting tools and data analytics solutions; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Other relevant languages are considered an advantage.

The successful candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial curiosity and a hands-on understanding of business operations. They are expected to be proactive, structured and collaborative, with the confidence to challenge the business constructively while building trust-based relationships across functions and countries.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please fill in the application form, including your CV and salary request by 11th October 2026.

For further information, please contact: Timo Koponen,e-mail timo.koponen@nokiantyres.com.

jobs.title: ENCARREGADOS DAS INDÚSTRIAS TÊXTEIS, DO VESTUÁRIO, CALÇADO E CURTUMES
jobs.description:
Procuramos um/a Encarregado/a Geral de Confeção experiente e dinâmico/a para liderar a nossa linha de produção dedicada à confeção de vestuário exterior em série. O/A profissional será responsável por garantir a máxima eficiência da linha de costura, bem como no sector de acabamento e embalagem, cumprindo os padrões de qualidade e os prazos estabelecidos.
Principais Responsabilidades:
* Gestão de equipa: Coordenar, motivar e distribuir tarefas à equipa de costureiras/os e operadores de acabamento.
* Planeamento de produção: Organizar o fluxo de trabalho e a alimentação das linhas de costura com base nos moldes e ordens de produção.
* Controlo de qualidade: Supervisionar a qualidade das costuras, acabamentos e conformidade das peças (roupões e similares) ao longo do processo.
* Afinação e tempos: Identificar estrangulamentos na produção, ajustar a distribuição de tarefas para otimizar tempos e garantir o cumprimento de metas.
* Apoio técnico: Esclarecer dúvidas técnicas da equipa relativas à montagem e acabamento das peças.
Perfil Pretendido:
* Experiência mínima comprovada de 1 ano como Encarregado/a ou Chefe de Linha em confeção industrial de vestuário.
* Conhecimento profundo de máquinas de costura industriais (ponto corrido, corta e cose, entre outros, bem como demonstração de interesse em aprender com integração de outras máquinas
* Forte capacidade de liderança, organização e relacionamento interpessoal.
* Orientação para o cumprimento de objetivos e prazos de entrega.
O que Oferecemos:
* Contrato de trabalho a tempo inteiro com perspetiva de continuidade.
* Remuneração compatível com a experiência demonstrada + Subsídio de Alimentação.
* Integração numa empresa sólida no setor têxtil.
* Horário de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta-feira, das 08h00 às 17h10.

Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

Responsibilities
Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment.
Troubleshoot network incidents and connectivity issues.
Perform planned maintenance and participate in emergency recovery.
Handle technical requests from customers and internal teams.
Support network expansion, new location deployments, and automation projects.

At least three years of relevant networking experience.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN technologies.
Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and network redundancy.
Ability to diagnose routing, switching, latency, and packet-loss issues.
Experience configuring network equipment through CLI.
English at Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.

At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Good command of Slovak.

Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.title: Technici počítačových sietí a systémov
jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.
Follow established change-management, security, and documentation procedures.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

Asistentka / Asistent vedoucího výroby
Staňte se součástí týmu, který stojí za úspěchem značky ASAN.
Do našeho výrobního závodu v Miroticích hledáme spolehlivého a organizačně schopného kolegu či kolegyni, který/á bude důležitou oporou vedoucího výroby a pomůže zajišťovat hladký chod výroby od zásobování materiálem až po expedici hotových výrobků.
Pokud Vás baví organizace, práce s daty, komunikace s lidmi a hledáte pozici, kde budete mít přehled o tom, co se ve výrobě skutečně děje, pak by tato příležitost mohla být právě pro Vás.
O nás
Jsme Tommi CZ s.r.o., česká společnost s více než 30letou historií a jeden z významných hráčů na trhu chovatelských potřeb. Naše produkty nacházejí zákazníky ve více než 50 zemích světa a dlouhodobě patříme mezi respektované společnosti v oboru.
Ve výrobním závodě v Miroticích vyrábíme ekologické stelivo ASAN, které získalo prestižní ocenění World Brand Award a dnes patří mezi nejuznávanější produkty svého druhu.
Za každým úspěšným výrobkem stojí lidé, kteří dokáží spojit organizaci, odpovědnost a týmovou spolupráci. A právě takového člověka hledáme.
Co bude Vaším úkolem
Budete jedním z klíčových článků mezi administrativou a výrobou. Vaše práce bude mít přímý vliv na to, jak efektivně výroba funguje každý den.

Nákup materiálu, komunikace s dodavateli a řešení provozních požadavků

Koordinace přípravných prací před zahájením výroby
Dohled nad plynulým balením hotových výrobků
Spolupráce při přípravě ISO auditů a vedení agendy odpadového hospodářství
Zajištění chodu balicí linky v době dovolených nebo nepřítomnosti kolegů
Péče o pořádek a organizaci administrativního zázemí výroby
Koho hledáme
Hledáme člověka, který dokáže převzít odpovědnost, má rád pořádek ve věcech a umí si poradit i v situacích, kdy je potřeba rychle reagovat.

jobs.title: Restaurant Supervisor hotelové restaurace ENDEMIT Boutique Hotel & Spa, Řídící pracovníci v restauracích
jobs.description:
Jak bude vypadat tvůj den?
Budeš oporou týmu obsluhy během směny a tím, kdo udává tempo i náladu. Přivítáš hosty, pomůžeš kolegům v náročnějších chvílích a postaráš se o to, aby servis fungoval hladce od prvního ranního úsměvu až po poslední večerní kávu.
Čeká tě spolupráce s kuchyní i ostatními odděleními hotelu, zaškolování nových kolegů a řešení situací, které přináší každý den v gastronomii. Zapojíš se také do organizace firemních akcí a dalších eventů.
Zkrátka práce, ve které nebudeš jen plnit úkoly, ale budeš mít možnost ovlivnit celkový zážitek našich hostů.

Koho hledáme?
Máš zkušenosti z restaurace, hotelu nebo gastronomie a umíš vést lidi příkladem.
Jsi komunikativní, samostatný/á a spolehlivý/á. Nezalekneš se rušnějšího provozu ani nečekaných situací a záleží ti na tom, aby host odjížděl spokojený.
Domluvíš se alespoň základy angličtiny a máš chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady.

Co Vám můžeme nabídnout:
-    stabilní práci na hlavní pracovní poměr
-    možnost ubytování mezi směnami
-    zaměstnanecké benefity a zvýhodněné služby hotelu
-    prostor pro vlastní nápady a jejich realizaci
-    přátelský tým, který táhne za jeden provaz
-    práci v moderním boutique hotelu obklopeném beskydskou přírodou

PRVNÍ KONTAKT: telefonicky 703 188 188 Ing. Peter Krupka PO-PÁ v době od 8:00 do 16:30 h, emailem na: peter.krupka@endemithotel.cz nebo osobně na pracovišti

jobs.title: Technicien.ne de maintenance (Evreux)
jobs.description:
Pourquoi ce poste est important ?

Chez Exotec, nous concevons et maintenons des systèmes robotiques de pointe qui transforment les entrepôts dans le monde entier. Chaque jour, notre technologie contribue à rendre les opérations plus sûres, plus rapides et moins exigeantes physiquement. En tant que Technicien de Maintenance, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bon fonctionnement de ces systèmes et offrir des performances exceptionnelles à nos clients.

Pourquoi vous apprécierez travailler chez nous ?

  • Travailler avec des technologies robotiques de dernière génération.
  • Rejoindre de petites équipes soudées où chacun a un réel impact.
  • Évoluer dans des environnements de travail modernes et propres.
  • Bénéficier d’une grande autonomie pour diagnostiquer les problèmes et trouver des solutions.

Vos missions

  • Assurer le fonctionnement optimal du système Skypod® et de notre flotte de robots.
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes mécaniques, électriques et logicielles.
  • Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les sites clients.
  • Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour résoudre des problématiques complexes.
  • Améliorer la fiabilité des systèmes et les performances clients.
  • Participer à la formation des clients et offrir une expérience de service d’excellence.

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Salaire annuel brut compétitif + prime d’équipe/poste + augmentation salariale complémentaire (%) selon l’organisation du temps de travail applicable et conformément à la convention collective + bonus annuel ExoBonus.
  • Tickets restaurant, RTT, mutuelle compétitive, prime vacances.
  • Organisation du travail du lundi au vendredi - 39h hebdomadaire. Travail de nuit et le week-end possible.
  • Horaires :
    • En horaires de journée (8h-17h30 : modulable)
  • Poste basé à Evreux (27)
  • Déplacements ponctuels possible en Normandie

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 ans d’expérience en maintenance industrielle, avec de solides compétences en diagnostic mécanique et électrique.
    • Connaissance pratique de la maintenance préventive et corrective sur :
      • systèmes de convoyage,
      • roulements,
      • courroies,
      • chaînes,
      • rouleaux,
      • moteurs,
      • variateurs,
      • capteurs,
      • actionneurs.

    • Capacité à lire des schémas électriques, surveiller les performances des systèmes et réaliser un premier niveau de diagnostic logiciel.
    • Calme et fiable, capable de résoudre rapidement les pannes, d’identifier les causes racines et de prendre des décisions sous pression.
    • Esprit curieux, sens du service client, goût du travail en équipe et excellente communication.

Processus de recrutement

Rejoignez-nous en seulement 2 semaines !

    1. Postulez en ligne.
    2. Notre objectif est de vous contacter sous 5 jours pour un premier échange téléphonique.
    3. Dans les 5 jours suivants, nous vous inviterons à visiter le site, rencontrer l’équipe, réaliser un exercice technique de diagnostic de panne et échanger avec le responsable du recrutement.
    4. Réception de votre proposition d’embauche dans les 4 jours suivant les entretiens.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi.

Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences.
En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

Pour postuler, veuillez envoyer votre CV. Seul·e·s les candidat·e·s présélectionné·e·s seront contacté·e·s pour les prochaines étapes du processus de recrutement. Au plaisir de recevoir votre candidature ! Si vous postulez à un poste en Europe, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité pour plus de détails.

jobs.title: Onderhoudsmedewerker / Klusser Universiteit Tilburg (vacature voor doelgroep Banenafspraak)
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met praktisch onderhoudswerk en vind je het leuk om ervoor te zorgen dat gebouwen en ruimtes netjes en goed blijven functioneren? Dan sluit jouw ervaring goed aan bij deze functie.

Je hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als huismeester, conciërge, klusser, facilitair medewerker, technisch medewerker of in een vergelijkbare functie waarin je praktische werkzaamheden uitvoerde. Je bent gewend om kleine reparaties te doen, problemen op te lossen en ervoor te zorgen dat spullen, ruimtes en gebouwen goed onderhouden blijven.

Je hebt ervaring met werkzaamheden zoals het oplossen van kleine storingen, repareren van meubels en inventaris, ophangen van materialen, vervangen van onderdelen en het uitvoeren van verschillende klussen in en rondom gebouwen. Je vindt het leuk om afwisselend werk te doen en pakt verschillende werkzaamheden zelfstandig op.

Je kunt goed luisteren naar opdrachten en werkt netjes en zorgvuldig. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren en vindt het belangrijk dat de studenten, medewerkers en bezoekers zich prettig en veilig voelen in de gebouwen van Tilburg University.

Ervaring met facilitaire werkzaamheden, gebouwbeheer, onderhoud van scholen, kantoren of andere gebouwen is een voordeel. Een technische opleiding is niet het belangrijkste; jouw praktische ervaring, motivatie en bereidheid om nieuwe dingen te leren zijn belangrijk.

Een rijbewijs B is vereist, omdat je met een servicewagentje over het campusterrein rijdt.

Werk jij graag met je handen en vind je het leuk om ervoor te zorgen dat gebouwen goed blijven functioneren? Dan is deze functie bij Tilburg University misschien iets voor jou.

Als onderhoudsmedewerker help je mee om de campus netjes, veilig en prettig te houden voor de duizenden studenten, medewerkers en bezoekers. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat kleine (technische) problemen worden opgelost en dat ruimtes en voorzieningen goed blijven werken.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag loop je controlerondes door de gebouwen en voer je kleine reparaties uit. De andere dag los je een storing op, help je bij onderhoudswerkzaamheden of ondersteun je bij een evenement. Je werkt vaak zelfstandig, maar kunt altijd overleggen met je collega's.

Je ziet direct het resultaat van je werk: een gebouw dat goed functioneert en een omgeving waarin mensen prettig kunnen werken en studeren. Heb jij technische aanleg, ben je handig en vind je het leuk om verschillende praktische werkzaamheden uit te voeren? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.

Deze vacature is bedoeld voor kandidaten uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak of kandidaten die via de praktijkroute een DGR-indicatie kunnen verkrijgen.

jobs.title: Meewerkend voorman buitenterrein Universiteit Tilburg (vacature voor doelgroep Banenafspraak)
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met groenonderhoud, terreinonderhoud of ander praktisch werk buiten en heb je graag de verantwoordelijkheid om het overzicht te houden en collega's te begeleiden? Als meewerkend voorman/vrouw combineer je jouw eigen werkzaamheden met het ondersteunen, motiveren en aansturen van collega's op de werkvloer.

Je bent gewend om zelfstandig werkzaamheden uit te voeren en samen met collega's te zorgen voor een nette en veilige omgeving.

In deze functie combineer je uitvoerend werk met het begeleiden van collega's op de werkvloer. Je hebt ervaring met het geven van uitleg, het verdelen van werkzaamheden en het ondersteunen van collega's tijdens hun dagelijkse taken. Je vindt het leuk om een aanspreekpunt te zijn, houdt overzicht en stemt af met de teamleider over de planning en voortgang van het werk.

Je hebt ervaring met werkzaamheden zoals groenonderhoud, terreinbeheer en het netjes houden van een buitenomgeving. Denk hierbij aan bladruimen, bladblazen, onkruid verwijderen, bomen en planten verzorgen, afval opruimen, kleine onderhoudswerkzaamheden uitvoeren en zorgen dat het terrein schoon en verzorgd blijft.

Je kunt zelfstandig werken, ziet wat er moet gebeuren en vindt het belangrijk dat werkzaamheden goed en netjes worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt zorgvuldig, komt afspraken na en kunt goed omgaan met verschillende collega's. Ervaring met het begeleiden van medewerkers uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak of Participatiewet is een pré.

Ervaring met eenvoudige administratieve werkzaamheden, zoals werken met digitale werkbonnen, registraties of voorraadbeheer, is mooi meegenomen. Een specifieke opleiding is niet het belangrijkste; jouw praktische ervaring, motivatie en manier van samenwerken zijn voor deze functie belangrijk.

Een rijbewijs B is gewenst, vanwege rijden met servicewagentje over campusterrein. Deze vacature is bedoeld voor kandidaten uit doelgroep Banenafspraak.

Tilburg University zoekt vanwege het vertrek van onze huidige collega een meewerkend voorman/vrouw voor het buitenterrein. Wil jij werken in een groene omgeving waar jouw inzet direct zichtbaar resultaat heeft? Vind je het leuk om buiten bezig te zijn én collega's te begeleiden? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.

Als meewerkend voorman/vrouw buitenterrein zorg je samen met je collega's voor een schone, veilige en verzorgde campus. Je combineert praktische werkzaamheden in het groen en terreinonderhoud met een coördinerende rol op de werkvloer. Je helpt collega's uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak om hun werkzaamheden goed uit te voeren, houdt overzicht en bent het aanspreekpunt bij vragen.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag houd je toezicht op de werkzaamheden, begeleid je collega's en stem je de planning af met de teamleider. De andere dag werk je mee aan het onderhoud van het terrein, zoals groenonderhoud, het netjes houden van de campus, kleine herstelwerkzaamheden en het voorbereiden van evenementen. Je werkt veel buiten en draagt zichtbaar bij aan een prettige omgeving voor studenten, medewerkers en bezoekers van Tilburg University.

De uitdaging in deze functie zit in de combinatie van zelfstandig werken, samenwerken en het bieden van ondersteuning aan collega's. Je houdt het overzicht, zorgt voor kwaliteit en weet je aan te passen aan verschillende situaties. Heb jij ervaring met terreinonderhoud, werk je graag buiten een vind je het leuk om collega's te begeleiden en te ondersteunen in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.

Deze vacature is bedoeld voor kandidaten uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak.
