jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Prozesskammern ECD (Electrochemical Deposition) (all genders)
jobs.description:
1 Mechanical Engineer - Prozesskammern ECD (Electrochemical Deposition) (all genders) Job-ID: 203292 I Work Location Model: On-site Flex I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

Dein Beitrag
Als Mechanical Engineer für ECD-Prozesskammern übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für bestehende Produkte und unterstützen deren kontinuierliche Verbesserung hinsichtlich Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit, Kosten, Qualität und Fertigbarkeit. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kund:innen, Fertigung, Service, Lieferant:innen und internen Entwicklungsteams zusammen, um technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und bestehende Systeme an neue Anforderungen anzupassen.

Deine Aufgaben
* Betreuung und technische Weiterentwicklung bestehender ECD-Prozesskammern und ihrer mechanischen Baugruppen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus
* Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Designverbesserungen zur Steigerung von Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Produktperformance
* Umsetzung kundenspezifischer Anpassungen und Sonderlösungen in enger Abstimmung mit Kunden, Vertrieb und Applikationsteams
* Analyse von Feldproblemen, Kund:inneneskalationen und Fertigungsabweichungen sowie Durchführung strukturierter Ursachenanalysen (Root Cause Analysis)
* Definition, Planung und Durchführung von Validierungs- und Verifikationstests für Designänderungen
* Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigung, Service, Qualität, Einkauf und Lieferant:innen zur Identifikation und Umsetzung technischer Verbesserungen
* Unterstützung bei Kostenreduktionsmaßnahmen, Lieferant:innenqualifizierungen und Obsoleszenzmanagement
* Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Spezifikationen, Änderungsanträge, FMEAs und Risikobewertungen
* Analyse mechanischer, thermischer und fluidischer Fragestellungen innerhalb von nasschemischen Prozesssystemen
* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Lam-Standards, SEMI-Richtlinien und Konstruktionsvorgaben
* Präsentation technischer Lösungen und Ergebnisse in interdisziplinären Design Reviews

Wen wir suchen
Mindestqualifikation

* Abgeschlossene HTL, oder Bachelor Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Verfahrenstechnik oder vergleichbarer technischer Fachrichtung
* Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich mechanische Konstruktion, Produktengineering oder Anlagenbau
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit 3D-CAD-Systemen wie SolidEdge, Siemens NX oder vergleichbaren Konstruktionswerkzeugen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich technischer Problemlösung und strukturierter Fehleranalyse
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld
* Der Position entsprechend gute Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

* Erfahrung mit nasschemischen Prozessanlagen, fluidischen Systemen oder chemischen Prozessumgebungen.
* Kenntnisse in Electrochemical Deposition (ECD), Wet Processing oder verwandten Halbleiterprozessen.
* Erfahrung mit Werkstoffauswahl und chemischer Kompatibilität von Kunststoffen, Metallen, Elastomeren und Beschichtungen in aggressiven Medien.
* Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Dichtungstechnik, Fluidverteilung und Thermomanagement
* Erfahrung mit Änderungsmanagement, Produktpflege und technischen Verbesserungsprojekten.
* Kenntnisse von FMEA, Design Reviews und strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden wie 8D oder Ishikawa.

Was wir bieten

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

  • Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

  • Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

  • Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

  • Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

  • Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

  • Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

  • Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful.   • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

 - Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

 - Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented infrastructure depth. You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

 - Safe-change and production judgment. You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

 - Platform-product and engineering judgment. You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

 - Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

 - A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Otsime Sind, kes Sa oled valmis vastutama kvaliteetselt osutatud erihoolekandeteenuste eest.

Tööülesanded: Erihoolekandeteenuste klienditööjuht on oluline juhtkonna liige, kelle peamiseks ülesandeks on tagada kõikidele erihoolekandeteenuste klientidele kvaliteetse teenuse pakkumine.
Sinu töö on mitmekülgne ning väljakutsuv. Me pakume erihoolekandeteenuseid kokku 200 kliendile, eesmärgiga parandada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti. Saad anda olulise panuse organisatsiooni ja valdkonna arengusse. Sul on võimalus toetada ühiskonnas erivajadusega inimestele võrdsete võimaluste loomist. Selle saavutamiseks peab klienditööjuht: - omama terviklikku ülevaadet kogu meie kliendibaasist; - toetama ja arendama tegevusjuhendajaid klienditöös; - juhendama tegevusjuhendajaid erinevates teemades, mh tegema individuaalseid vestluseid tegevusjuhendajatega; käima vajaduspõhiselt kaasas korteri koosolekutel; ettevalmistama juhendajat ja klienti SKAsse hindamistele minemisel; oskama soovitada kliendi juhendamiseks sobivaid metoodikaid, jne. - kasutama juhtumikorralduse põhimõtteid - märkama ja lahendama juhtumeid; - viima koos tegevusjuhendajaga läbi vajaduspõhiseid meeskonnatöid; - tegema koostööd juhtkonnaga; - tegema koostööd kvaliteedijuhiga; - korraldama tegevusjuhendajate asendused; - koordineerima päeva- ja tegevuskeskuste tegevusi, sh vaatama üle kuuplaanid; - integreerima alustavad tegevusjuhendajad tööellu; - koordineerima töötubade tööd; - juhendama praktikante.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume Sulle:
- toetavat kollektiivi; - regulaarseid juhtkonna kohtumisi väljakutsete arutamiseks; - avatud suhtlemisega ning arengule suunatud kolleege; - regulaarseid meeskonna infotunde; - juba toimivat meeskonda; - lisa puhkepäevad jõulude või aastavahetuse eel; - preemia tulemusliku töö eest. Meil on kokkuhoidev ja hea õhkkonnaga töökollektiiv. Sind ootab koostöövalmis juba toimiv meeskond, kus on avatud suhtlemine ning teineteisega arvestamine. Juhtkonna liikmena on Sul tagatud toetus teiste juhtkonna liikmete poolt. Me väärtustame arengut, mistõttu toimuvad regulaarselt koolitused ja õppereisid.

Muud nõuded: Tulemuslikuks klienditööjuhi töö tegemiseks on kindlasti vaja, et:

Oskused, mis oleks hea, et Sul on olemas enne tööle asumist: - julged oma arvamust avaldada, kuid suudad ellu viia ka teiste häid ideid; - Sul on olemas meeskonna juhtimise kogemus; - pead oluliseks kliendikeskset tööd ja võrgustikku kaasatust; - loomingulisus, mis aitab uutes olukordades vajalikke lahendusi leida; - huumorisoon, millega tööl tekkivatest väljakutsetest läbi minna; - valmisolek areneda koos kolleegide ja asutusega.

jobs.title: Lukksepp-keevitaja
jobs.description:
MIG/MAG keevitus -> rasketehnika /hüdrosilindrid

Tööülesanded: Sinu igapäevased kangelasteod:
Hüdrosilindri detailide keevitus: hülss/vars ja muud detailid. Kulbi terade vahetus: lõikus/keevitus. Detailide sirgestamine: (tõstuki kahvlid) kuumutamine/painutus/sirgestus. Rasketehnika masti ja detailide keevitus: mõrad- faasimine/keevitus. Ja palju muud... Meeskonna toetamine defekteerimisel ja masinate lahtivõtmisel. Töö on mitmekülgne ja eriprojekte on palju. Võimalus õppida juurde lihtsamat treitööd! Sellel teekonnal on toeks kogu meeskond, sest tihti hõlmab masina või hüdrosilindri remont mitut etappi: -Lahtivõtt ja defekteerimine -Pakkumise tegemine/eeldatavad töötunnid projektile -Tööde planeerimine -Võimalikud treitööd -Materjalide tellimine -Keevitus/kooste -Avade taastamine -Sirgestus -Uute detailide valmistamine /tellimine -Joonestamine -Hooldus -Montaaž See on ülevaade kogu meeskonna tööst! Kui oled meeskonnamängija, siis see üldsegi mitte igav ja mitmekülgne töö võib olla just Sulle! Me ei eelda, et Sa oskad kõike. Kui Sul on suur huvi rasketehnika ja metallitööde vastu, siis see on juba kõige olulisem. Kuulutuses märgitud palk ei ole ülempiir- see on meie miinimum. Initsiatiiv+motivatsioon+tööde teostamise kiirus= kõrgem palk! Kui soovid täpsemat tööde kirjeldust, siis helista või tule kohale meiega tutvuma!

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt on Sulle tasuta lõuna.
Maksame isikliku sõiduauto kompensatsiooni. Palk kuni 3500 € bruto. Kui planeerid ja teed oma tööd eriti hästi ja efektiivselt, tulevad mängu boonused – ehk siis 3500 € ei ole lagi! Hästi varustatud töökoda ja toetav tiim, kes hindab head nalja sama kõrgelt kui kvaliteetselt remonditud tehnikat.

Muud nõuded: Mida me Sinult ootame
Põhioskused: MIG/MAG keevitus. Oled eelisjärjekorras kui: Sul on varasem reaalne kokkupuude rasketehnika hooldusega, teadmised hüdraulikast, hüdrosilindritest ning tunned metalli ja selle töötlemist. Kuldne tase: kui oskad vahetada hüdrosilindril tihendid täiesti iseseisvalt ja seda ka testida/stendida (220bar). Oled meil kohe nimekirja tipus! Lisapunktid: TIG keevitus ja elektrood ning oskus teha lihtsamaid treitöid manuaalsel treipingil annavad sulle tugeva eelise. Võidab siiski kirg rasketehnika vastu ja soov/tahe töötada metalliga!

jobs.title: Nederlandstalige klantenservice in Athene
jobs.description:
Ben jij Nederlandstalig en lijkt het je leuk om in het zonnige Athene te wonen en werken? Wij bieden een interessante baan in de Nederlandstalige klantenservice, waarbij je internationale werkervaring kunt opdoen en tegelijkertijd kunt genieten van het leven in Griekenland.

Op de werkvloer werken al veel Nederlanders, Scandinaviërs en collega's uit verschillende andere Europese landen. Je komt terecht in een internationale omgeving en krijgt volop de kans om nieuwe mensen te leren kennen tijdens je verblijf in Athene.

Wij staan gedurende je hele verblijf in Athene voor je klaar. Heb je vragen of hulp nodig? Dan kun je altijd kosteloos contact met ons opnemen. We kennen Griekenland goed en helpen je graag met praktische zaken en andere vragen die tijdens je verblijf kunnen ontstaan.

Wat bieden wij jou in Athene?

● Gratis vliegticket naar Athene.

● Gratis hotelaccommodatie gedurende de eerste 2–3 weken.

● Hulp bij het vinden van permanente woonruimte.

● Een competitief salaris.

● Een 5-daagse werkweek met diensten van 8 uur.

● Een positieve en internationale werkomgeving met leuke collega's.

● Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de klantenservice door middel van trainingen en certificeringen.

● Hulp met praktische zaken, zoals bankzaken, belastingen en zorgverzekering.

Wat ga je doen?

Je gaat aan de slag in de Nederlandstalige klantenservice en helpt Nederlandstalige klanten met vragen over verzekeringen en productbescherming voor elektronische apparaten die in winkels zijn gekocht.

Je beantwoordt vragen over de verzekeringsdekking, behandelt schadeclaims en helpt klanten bij het oplossen van verschillende problemen. Complexere situaties worden, indien nodig, volgens de geldende procedures doorgestuurd naar het juiste team.

Het gaat om klantenservice en ondersteuning – niet om de verkoop van verzekeringen.

Voordat je begint, krijg je een uitgebreide en volledig betaalde training. Ook tijdens je werk kun je rekenen op ondersteuning van je leidinggevende en de rest van het team.

Wie zoeken wij?

● Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

● Je hebt een goede beheersing van het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

● Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en vindt het leuk om klanten te helpen.

● Je bent flexibel wat betreft wisselende werktijden.

● Je bent bereid om minimaal 6 maanden in Athene te wonen en werken.

● Je bent digitaal vaardig en kunt goed overweg met computers en digitale communicatie.

● Je kunt in een dynamische omgeving werken en blijft rustig wanneer het druk is.

● Je hebt een geldig paspoort en kunt een blanco strafblad aantonen.

● Je bent minimaal 18 jaar oud.

Wij hebben het hele jaar door vacatures voor Nederlandstaligen in Athene en kunnen, waar mogelijk, de startdatum afstemmen op jouw situatie.

Heb je vragen? Neem dan gerust contact met ons op via +45 4252 3737 of per e-mail via kontakt@jobsun.dk.

jobs.title: RESPONSABLE DE SITE ITINERANT (H/F)
jobs.description:
Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F)

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?
Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F) et devenez un véritable référent opérationnel au sein de notre réseau de 16 résidences Appart'Hôtels implantées dans la partie Est de France.

Qui sommes-nous ?
KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.
Nous accueillons étudiants, professionnels et voyageurs en leur proposant des solutions d'hébergement tout confort, de la nuitée au séjour longue durée. Nos appartements, du studio au T2, sont entièrement meublés et équipés, avec Wi-Fi et de nombreux services à la carte.
Vous recherchez un poste où autonomie, diversité des missions et proximité avec la direction sont une réalité ? Rejoignez Kosy et participez au développement de notre réseau de résidences.
Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Votre mission :
Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- (Co)-piloter l'exploitation quotidienne d'une résidence ;
- Garantir un accueil client de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction de nos résidents et clients ;
- Accompagner, coordonner et soutenir les équipes présentes sur site (interne ou externe) ;
- Suivre l'activité commerciale et respecter les objectifs de taux d'occupation ;
- Assurer le suivi administratif et opérationnel de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;
- Accompagner les équipes lors des périodes de forte activité et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de leurs process.

Profil souhaité :
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
- votre autonomie ;
- votre capacité d'adaptation ;
- votre sens de l'organisation ;
- votre réactivité ;
Vous appréciez les environnements variés, savez rapidement prendre vos marques dans un nouvel établissement et aimez relever de nouveaux défis.
Ce poste implique des déplacements de 2 à 3 semaines par trimestre, principalement sur nos résidences de Reims, Mâcon, Saint-Avold et Grenoble, afin d'assurer les remplacements ou de renforcer les équipes selon les besoins de l'exploitation.
Vous êtes directement rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel.
En dehors des périodes de remplacement, le poste est rattaché au siège, à Nancy.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
- Une grande autonomie dans vos missions.
- Une forte diversité d'environnements et de rencontres.
- Une proximité immédiate avec la direction générale.
- L'opportunité de développer vos compétences sur plusieurs typologies d'établissements.
- Une entreprise à taille humaine, attachée à la proximité, à la qualité de service et à l'accompagnement de ses équipes.

Informations complémentaires
- CDI - 39h
- Statut : Agent de Maîtrise
- Convention collective de l'immobilier (IDCC 1527)
- Mutuelle d'entreprise
- Prise en charge des déplacements et hébergement par Kosy lors des missions.
- Rémunération annuelle brute : 33 000 € sur 13 mois

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements, 1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité - nous recherchons un**-**e Software Engineer senior aussi bien à l'aise avec Django que React pour nous aider à accélérer, se connecter à plus de fabricants et améliorer l'impact de l'application. Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.
Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.
Tes missions :
- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)

- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques

- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré

- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateforme

Profil recherché
À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipe

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)

- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métie

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Orchestration de taches: Celery

- Cache : Redis

Frontend Web
- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natif

Base de Données
- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles

- NoSQL : MongoDB pour la gestion de données semi-structurées / documents

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

- Documentation : Slite

- Contrôle de version : GitLab

Tu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?
Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?
Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?
Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !
Nos valeurs :
- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.

- User focused : à l'écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de nos services et de nos produits.

- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l'humilité et l'honnêteté.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :

jobs.title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.

  • Partner & Ecosystem Management: Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what “earning with Ledger” means for our users.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance — especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.

jobs.title: Founding Data Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,
- Recherche des solutions à toutes situations problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ou avec les parties prenantes en créant de nouvelle procédure au besoin.
- Fais de chaque expérience une analyse permettant d'améliorer les procédures dans l'ensemble.

PILOTAGE FINANCIER ET ADMINISTRATIF DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- S'assure du respect des objectifs budgétaires fixés par la direction Providex et des objectifs d'approvisionnement de biomasse, il engage et suit les commandes de biomasse auprès des fournisseurs en concertation avec la direction,
- Tient à jours les indicateurs de coûts sur la biomasse en concertation avec la responsable de parc à bois qui suit la réception de la biomasse,
- Analyse les indicateurs, pointe les écarts et dysfonctionnements, propose des solutions à la direction.

MANAGEMENT DES ÉQUIPES DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :

- Assure la mise en place de procédure adéquate avec le ou la SQE sur les chantiers de mobilisation.

SÉCURITÉ :
- Suit et veille à faire appliquer les recommandations du SQE  sur les chantiers,
- Informe la direction et QSEE de tout incident, accident ou situation à risque, et traite l'anomalie en conséquence,
- Veille à l'application de toutes les règles et procédures de sécurité établies.

ENVIRONNEMENT :
- Veille en permanence au respect absolu des normes environnementale sur chantier,
- Anticipe toutes anomalies à venir, agit et fait agir en conséquence.

QUALITÉ :
- Décline la politique qualité qui sera déployée,
- Applique et fait appliquer les procédures du SMI,
- Suit les non conformités, actions correctives et préventives,
- Renseigne et suit les indicateurs biomasse mis en place par la direction,
- Suit et applique les recommandations du QSEE,
- Informe le personnel de la politique et de l'application des dispositions Qualité qui seront mis en place.

jobs.title: Marketing Director

ABOUT THE COMPANY Tiger of Sweden is a Stockholm-based fashion house established in 1903 with a heritage in tailoring. For more than a century, Tiger of Sweden has stood for style with purpose, dressing men and women for whom true style is about the confidence to be themselves.

POSITION OVERVIEW As Marketing Director, you will build brand equity, elevate brand visibility, and fuel brand desirability for Tiger of Sweden globally. You should possess a deep understanding of brand strategy, consumer behaviour, and digital marketing, along with a proven track record of developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will set the brand strategy, lead all marketing, PR and campaign work, and build a high-performing Marketing & PR team across locations. You will work closely with the CEO and the entire management team, and represent the brand externally to agencies, press, industry opinion leaders, fashion influencers and celebrities. The role involves regular travel.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Customer Insight:

    

Set the brand strategy for Tiger of Sweden, from target customer to visual identity and tone of voice, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Create a distinctive and inspiring brand community around Tiger of Sweden at a global scale.

    

Gain a deep understanding of current and target customers through qualitative and quantitative research and the Tiger Society customer database.

    

Share customer insights with the commercial, design, and product functions.

    

Ensure a consistent tone of voice across all channels globally (English, German, Swedish).

    

Act as the brand's north star, safeguarding 360-degree consistency across all owned and third-party channels.

Marketing, Campaigns & PR:

    

Develop and implement annual, seasonal, and project-based marketing and PR strategies.

    

Lead the conception, creation, and production (film, photo, editorial) of all marketing campaigns, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Lead the cross-functional 360 marketing and sales calendar planning and the weekly editorial meeting.

    

Drive online and offline media coverage, ensuring both quality and scale.

    

Drive the global influencer marketing strategy to increase visibility and awareness on social media.

    

Oversee and set a structure for global and local agencies and third-party service providers.

Retail, Store Concept & Events:

    

Lead the store design concept for all points of sale, directing external partners and delivering projects on time and on budget.

    

Co-develop in-store activations and create seasonal and theme-based window concepts.

    

Plan and manage brand events, such as fashion presentations, influencer experiences, store events, panel talks and live shopping.

    

Co-lead line release meetings with Sales and Design, and support selling-in with brand material such as lookbooks, virtual showrooms and brand presentations.

    

Support the Wholesale, Retail and eCom teams in reaching commercial targets.

    

Direct the creation of all branding-relevant physical assets, from stationery to packaging and signage.

Brand Development & Partnerships:

    

Develop a long-term licensing strategy, identifying suitable partners and setting up brand-enhancing, commercially attractive agreements.

    

Act as a brand ambassador for Tiger of Sweden.

Team Leadership & Budget:

    

Lead, develop, and mentor the Marketing & PR team, empowering existing talent to deliver excellence.

    

Manage the global Marketing & PR budget.

    

Set up relevant KPIs and reviews to ensure efficient and effective budget allocation, taking corrective action as needed.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

    

10+ years of experience in Marketing & PR.

    

Proven track record in developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands.

    

Experience working for a global fashion brand, preferably in a premium or luxury environment.

    

Experience directing creative and art direction for a global fashion or lifestyle brand.

    

Excellent knowledge of digital marketing, sales channels, and the latest digital trends.

    

Experience managing external agencies and senior, high-profile stakeholders.

    

Proven people leader with the ability to build successful cross-functional partnerships.

    

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English.

    

Strong eye for brand-consistent visual storytelling.

    

Highly organised, able to juggle priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    

Creative, entrepreneurial and results-driven.

    

Culturally aware and highly engaged in the industry, current trends and events.

    

Team player with a positive, can-do attitude.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

    

Microsoft Office

The position is based in our Head Office in Stockholm and is a full-time position. Does this sound like the perfect fit for you? Please don't hesitate to apply by submitting a CV and personal letter in English. We look forward to receiving your application.

Tiger of Sweden stands against any form of discrimination and strives to be an inclusive brand and workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race or disability, and recruitment is based purely on skills and experience.

jobs.description:
Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator — MK STUDIO, Glostrup

Hourly paid · 150 DKK/hour · Minimum 32 h/week guaranteed, Mon–Fri · Up to 40 h/week in busy periods · Start October–November 2026

MK STUDIO (mk-ceramics ApS) makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. We're a team of seven across the workshop, office and our Copenhagen shop, selling to cafés, roasters and coffee people across Denmark, the EU and Asia.

In a strong week we make 500–1000 cups. We're looking for the person who gets every order out the door correctly and makes sure nothing leaves the studio with a defect.

What you'll do

Orders and customers (about half your week)

  • Pack 10–15 webshop orders a day, plus wholesale (B2B) orders

  • Book shipments and print labels in the DHL and UPS apps

  • Prepare invoices, packing lists and customs documents for shipments outside the EU

  • Answer all order and customer emails: order status, delays, returns, breakage claims

  • Handle claims with carriers for damaged or lost parcels

  • Keep packing materials in stock

Studio and stock (about half your week)

  • Unload kilns after the glaze firing

  • Check every piece and sort it: first quality, seconds, reject

  • Finishing work on fired pieces

  • Organise the stock room and keep stock numbers correct in our order system

You're the last check before a piece reaches a customer.

What you need

  • Fluent written and spoken English — you'll talk and write to customers every day

  • Right to work in Denmark

  • You can lift and carry up to 20 kg (kiln shelves, boxes) and work on your feet most of the day in a studio with clay dust

  • Available Monday to Friday, at least 32 hours a week, with extra hours in busy periods, from October–November 2026

  • Experience with order handling, shipping, warehouse, e-commerce, customer service or similar work

  • You plan your own day, handle several tasks at once, and flag mistakes early

Good to have

  • Danish

  • Driving licence

  • DHL/UPS bookings and claims

  • Customs or export paperwork

  • Experience packing fragile goods (glass, ceramics, wine)

  • e-conomic, Shopify or spreadsheets

  • Ceramics or quality-control experience

What we offer

  • 150 DKK/hour, plus holiday pay

  • 32 guaranteed hours a week

  • 3-month trial period

  • After 6 months, we sit down and negotiate your pay based on your performance and any extra tasks you've taken on

  • A small team with short lines and fast decisions

  • Full training in our systems and quality standards

How to apply

Apply through the form at www.mk-ceramics.com/pages/mk-studio-work-with-us (select "Packing").

Write a short message telling us why you'd like to work with us and why you think you're a good fit for this job. Then answer these five questions with yes or no, based on this job ad:

  1. Is this job paid by the hour?

  2. Is the guaranteed minimum 40 hours a week?

  3. Is about half of the job packing orders and answering customer emails?

  4. Do you need to work weekends in this job?

  5. Does the job start in January 2027?

We'll reply by email and ask for your CV.

Le poste

InsideBoard est la plateforme d'IA dédiée à la conduite du changement. Nous accompagnons l'adoption et la performance chez les plus grandes entreprises mondiales (Stellantis, General Motors, Michelin, La Poste, Pernod Ricard, et d'autres).
En tant que Solution Engineer, vous êtes le pont technique entre nos clients et la plateforme : vous participez aux ateliers client, vous captez les besoins, puis vous utilisez le développement assisté par IA (Claude Code, Windsurf et notre outillage d'agents interne) pour configurer, intégrer et étendre la plateforme InsideBoard, souvent dans la même semaine.

Ce n'est pas un poste d'ingénieur logiciel classique, et vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser toutes les technologies de notre stack. Vous orchestrez des agents IA sur un écosystème interne bien documenté (surface d'API, automatisation n8n, conventions pensées pour les agents).
L'IA écrit la majeure partie du code ; votre travail consiste à savoir ce qu'elle fait, à vérifier qu'elle fait la bonne chose, et à l'arrêter quand ce n'est pas le cas. Et vous portez la relation client sur le volet technique.

Vos missions

Face au client (environ 50 %)

  • Animer des ateliers de cadrage et de spécification avec des clients grands comptes (en français et en anglais), du kickoﬀ aux comités de pilotage (COPIL).
  • Transformer les réunions en livrables actionnables : spécifications fonctionnelles, matrices de statut, wireframes, guides d'intégration, guides utilisateur, comptes rendus avec décisions validées.
  • Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation.
  • Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production.

Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %)

  • Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags.
  • Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack.
  • Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes.
  • Brancher des fonctionnalités LLM pour les clients : synthèses de performance générées par IA, pipelines OCR, bases de connaissances RAG, conception de prompts d'agents.
Le profil recherché

Vous n'avez pas besoin de connaître toutes les technologies que nous utilisons. Il vous faut assez de profondeur technique pour superviser une IA qui les connaît : comprendre son plan, poser les bonnes questions, repérer quand elle dérive, et valider le résultat avant qu'il n'atteigne un client.

Indispensable

  • Une vraie maîtrise des agents de code IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf ou équivalent) : vous savez spécifier une tâche précisément, piloter l'agent, relire sa production avec un œil critique et vérifier le résultat. Vous savez aussi quand ne pas lui faire confiance.
  • Une capacité de contrôle technique : vous lisez un diﬀ ou un log suﬃsamment bien pour comprendre ce qui a changé et pourquoi, vous suivez un appel API de bout en bout, vous vérifiez la cohérence d'une transformation de données et vous testez ce que l'IA a construit avant de livrer.
  • Écrire du code de zéro n'est pas exigé.
  • Une aisance avec les API REST : authentification, pagination, rate limits ; à l'aise avec la plomberie de données JSON/CSV/XLSX.
  • Une excellente communication client en français et en anglais : vous savez animer un atelier, recadrer avec diplomatie et écrire des documents qu'un DSI lira.
  • De la rigueur et de la prudence avec les données de production : dry-runs, plans de rollback,logs. Vous faites mesurer deux fois à l'IA avant toute mise à jour en masse.
Un plus
  • Une expérience de développement (TypeScript, Python), utile mais non requise.
  • Une expérience avec n8n, Zapier, Make ou une plateforme d'automatisation similaire.
  • Une exposition aux écosystèmes d'entreprise : Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP , SSO.
  • Une expérience d'intégration LLM (API OpenAI/Anthropic/Mistral, RAG, conception de prompts).
  • Un passé en adoption SaaS, conduite du changement ou customer success engineering.
 
Processus de recrutement :
Un appel initial de 15 minutes sera programmé avec Shelly dès que votre candidature sera approuvée puis un entretien RH avec Shelly de nouveau.
Ensuite, vous aurez un entretien d'une heure pour discuter de vos expériences, motivations et de notre entreprise avec  Sébastien
Vous rencontrerez votre future manager, Manan, pour discuter plus en détail du rôle, de vos compétences et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir.
Enfin, un appel téléphonique avec Michael, l'un des directeurs d'InsideBoard AI, clôturera le processus.
 
Ce que nous offrons

jobs.title: Er du klar for et viktig samfunnsoppdrag og forvalte en stor eiendomsportefølje?
jobs.description:
Boligstiftelsen etablerte egen administrasjon som overtok forvaltningen av stiftelsen fra 2021 med daglig leder og driftssjef. I 2023 ansatte stiftelsen fire egne driftsteknikere etter at kommunen sa opp avtalen om vaktmestertjenester. 

 

Som daglig leder skal du forvalte og videreutvikle stiftelsen som en viktig samfunnsaktør i tett samarbeid med vår kunde og samarbeidspartner Ringerike kommune. Du skal videreføre det arbeidet som er igangsatt samtidig som du bidrar til å sette retning, ta tak i nye utfordringer, skape engasjement og sørge for gjennomføring av viktige prosjekter og oppgaver i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og styret.

 

Du får ansvaret for en driftsorganisasjon med høy eiendomsfaglig- og driftsmessig kompetanse.

 

Vi ser etter en leder som evner å kombinere strategisk blikk med operasjonell handlekraft og som skaper resultater sammen med andre.

 

 

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver vil være

●       Lede og videreutvikle stiftelsens arbeid

●       Sikre god økonomistyring og bærekraftig forvaltning og drift av eiendomsporteføljen

●       Videreutvikle relasjonene og samarbeidet med Ringerike Kommune

●       Utvikling – og reforhandling av avtaler

●       Styrke stiftelses omdømme som en viktig samfunnsaktør med stort samfunnsansvar

●       Videreutvikle standarder på tekniske og økonomiske områder

●       Lede ulike type prosjekter / prosjektutvikling

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker en trygg, tydelig og samlende leder med god økonomiforståelse, gode gjennomførings- og samarbeidsevner og som evner å sette retning for vår videre utvikling.

 

Du har erfaring fra lederstillinger med resultatansvar og kan vise til gode resultater når det gjelder utviklings- og forbedringsarbeid. Det er en fordel (behøver ikke) om du har erfaring fra eiendom, økonomi eller annen kompetanse- og tjenestebasert virksomhet. Det viktigste er at du evner å forstå vår virksomhet og se mulighetene som ligger foran oss og at du har kraft til å realisere dem i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og kunde/samarbeidspartner.

 

Høyere utdanning er ønskelig, men relevant ledererfaring kan kompensere for utdanning.

 

 

Vi håper du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse beskrivelsene

●       Du er en tydelig, troverdig og tillitsskapende leder

●       Du evner å bygge langsiktige relasjoner internt og eksternt

●       Du kommuniserer godt med kunder, samarbeidspartnere,       medarbeidere og andre

●       Du er tålmodig og har sterk gjennomføringskraft og evner å omsette  planer til handling

●       Du trives med å utvikle organisasjoner og mennesker

●       Du trives både med strategiske og operativt oppgaver

 

 

Ønsker du nærmere informasjon om stillingen så kontakter du Temp-Team ved Glenn G. Hovde på tlf. 982 44 777 eller epost gho@temp-team.no

Alle henvendelser til Temp-Team behandles konfidensielt om ønskelig også overfor Ringerike Boligstiftelse i innledende fase.

 

Søknad med CV lastes opp via stillingsannonsen.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest og senest 21.10.2026

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ringerike boligstiftelse er en alminnelig stiftelse opprettet av Ringerike kommune og Ringerike boligbyggelag i 1970 og forvalter 650 boenheter fordelt på ca. 62 000 kvm. Stiftelsens hovedformål er å skaffe boliger til tidsbegrenset utleie å erverve eller forestå oppføring av trygdeboliger, samt boliger og institusjoner til bruk for pleie- omsorg, helse og sosialtjenesten og leie ut leiligheter i slike bygg i Ringerike kommune. Ringerike boligstiftelse har som målsetting at eiendommene skal bidra til økt livskvalitet for beboerne og økt produktivitet for de ansatte.  Vi er lokalisert på Hvervenmoen i moderne lokaler og er 6 ansatte.

jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

jobs.title: Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Fixed-term | Full-time | Pietarsaari



We are looking for a Service Coordinator to join our Service Order Handling team in Pietarsaari for a fixed-term maternity leave replacement, lasting approximately until the end of 2027.

If you're a service-minded problem solver who enjoys coordinating tasks, communicating with customers, and keeping things on track, this could be the role for you. Youll play an important part in the customer journey, handling service orders, quotations, contracts, and deliveries while working with customers and colleagues around the world.



What will you do?

As a Service Coordinator, you'll be responsible for coordinating service-related orders and contracts for selected countries and ensuring a high-quality customer experience throughout the process.

Your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating incoming service orders and requests from customers in designated countries

- Preparing service and repair quotations based on information from our service technicians

- Communicating with customers and ensuring a smooth and professional service experience

- Coordinating return shipments for serviced equipment

- Managing invoicing and keeping information up to date in our systems

- Creating and administering service plan contracts, including orders and annual invoicing

You'll work closely with colleagues in our subsidiaries, representatives, Sales teams, and Service teams around the world.



Meet the team

You'll join a close-knit team consisting of five colleagues with a mix of junior to senior experience. We work closely together, support each other, and genuinely enjoy what we do.

While everyone is trusted to take ownership of their own work, nobody is left to figure things out alone. We encourage independent thinking and initiative, but help is always just a message or coffee break away.



What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility for their work, and can confidently keep several tasks moving forward at the same time.

You might have:

- A degree in business administration, commerce, or another relevant field

- Previous experience in customer service

- Experience in order handling, logistics, coordination, or administrative work



To succeed in this role, you will need:

- Strong English communication skills

- An independent and proactive way of working

- The ability to organize, prioritize, and manage your own workload

- A detail-oriented mindset

- A service-minded attitude and strong communication skills



Experience working with international customers, countries, and cultures is considered an advantage.

We also hope you're comfortable working with digital tools such as Microsoft Office, Teams, Dynamics, and other business systems, and that you're interested in learning new tools and ways of working.

Finnish language skills are an advantage, but the role can also be performed primarily in English.



What do we offer?

We are a global, family-owned technology company where people are trusted, supported, and encouraged to grow.

When you join us, you'll get:

- A full-time fixed-term position until the end of 2027

- Flexible hybrid working arrangements

- Thorough onboarding and support from an experienced team

- A positive team spirit and a culture where colleagues help each other succeed

- Opportunities to learn new skills and develop professionally

- The freedom to organize and take ownership of your own work

The salary range for this position is 2600-3400€ per month, and the final salary will be based on the selected candidates background and skills. In addition to your base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including Epassi (€400/year), extensive occupational healthcare, and the Auntie service to support mental wellbeing. Youll also have the opportunity to take part in Team Beamex events and activities throughout the year.



Interested? Wed love to hear from you!

Submit your application through our careers page and tell us a little about yourself, your background, and what sparked your interest in joining us as a Service Coordinator.

We review applications continuously and may begin interviews during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The application deadline is 11 October 2026.



If you have any questions or would like to learn more about the role, please feel free to contact:

Heli Nuora, Team Manager Business Operations

Heli.Nuora@beamex.com

+358 505703426




Beamex



Phone: +358 10 550 5000 Email: career@beamex.com Location: Pietarsaari / Finland
