jobs.title: Research coordinator at NORA
jobs.description:
About the position

We are seeking a candidate for a temporary 1-year position as research coordinator at NORA.ai. NORA is a national network hosted at the University of Oslo (UiO).

We are looking for an allrounder: a research coordinator to assist with tasks related to the NORA Research Schools, as well as tasks involving event organization, national and international research coordination activities and administrative tasks. You will be given the opportunity to build and strengthen Norwegian research and innovation within artificial intelligence - one of the most exciting and important research fields, mentioned as a priority area within Emergent and industrial technologies in Norway’s Long-Term Plan for Research and Higher Education.


About NORA

NORA - the Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research Consortium - is a national collaboration between 8 universities, 5 university colleges, and 4 research institutes within artificial intelligence, machine learning, and robotics. Our goal is to strengthen Norwegian research, education, and innovation in AI, machine learning, and robotics, as well as other relevant fields within artificial intelligence. Learn more about NORA at https://www.nora.ai. 

The NORA Secretariat consists of seven dedicated staff members with diverse cultural and academic backgrounds. The University of Oslo, through the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences and dScience - Centre for Computational and Data Science - hosts NORA. Our workplace is at Blindern, Oslo.


Your main tasks will be

Your main task will be to contribute to the organization of NORA's two Research Schools

  • NORA-tech (for cutting edge technologies within AI), and
  • NORA-HS (for humanities and societal questions within AI)

You will also contribute to the organization of other NORA events.

More about work tasks:

You will work closely with the CEO and the rest of the NORA secretariat. In particular, you will work closely with the Research Coordinator for the Research Schools and assist in the planning of research school events and their scientific content. You will also support the organization of NORA’s two main conferences and other national and international events. The tasks will be varied, and good collaboration skills are required. Some travelling must be expected.

Specific tasks will be:

  • Assist in the planning of the content and execution of research school events as well as NORA’s two main conferences, NORA’s Annual Conference and the Nordic AI Meet
  • Oversee logistics and execution of research school events
  • Prepare material about the research schools and the research school events for publication online
  • Invite speakers and provide guidance on presentation formats
  • You may also assist in the preparation of grant proposals
  • The position can be assigned other tasks

What skills are important in this role?

Qualification requirements:

In this role you must have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to AI, digitalisation, or data-driven research. Practical competence may replace the educational requirement
  • Experience with research administration and coordination, or research school administration and coordination
  • Experience organizing seminars, events, or conferences
  • Very good oral and written presentation in English
  • Good oral and written presentation in Norwegian

Desired qualifications:

  • A PhD and research experience are an advantage
  • Experience within the field of AI
  • Knowledge of research funding from NFR and/or the EU's research programs

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Independent, proactive, and solution-oriented
  • Good collaboration and communication skills
  • Positive and flexible attitude
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can handle various tasks
  • Ability to work in an interdisciplinary environment
  • Service-minded
  • Analytical and systematic

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Adviser, position code 1434 in salary range NOK 640 000 – 705 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • CV (complete overview of education and work experience)
  • Copies of the original bachelor’s and master’s degree diploma, transcripts of records
  • Copies of certificates
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society. 

dScience – Centre for Computational and Data Science at the University of Oslo is an interdisciplinary centre within science and technology. The centre establishes new, efficient mechanisms for collecting, processing, managing and sharing high-quality data for knowledge and business development in Norway and internationally. dScience works with basic, long-term research, creates collaboration across disciplines and sectors, offers digital services and contributes to the education and guidance of students. The center was established on 1 January 2021 with premises in the center of Blindern and is headed by Professor Morten Dæhlen.

jobs.title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
jobs.description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft 365 Administrator søges til Cimbria i Thisted eller Herning
jobs.description:
Er du den, der ser en M365-løsning, som kan gøres mere sikker, en proces, der kan automatiseres eller en struktur, der trænger til at blive strammet op - og tænker:

“Godt, det kan jeg få styr på.”

Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Til Grain & Protein Technologies søger vi netop nu en erfaren Microsoft 365 Administrator, som ikke bare driver og administrerer, men som tager ansvar for, at systemlandskabet fungerer og udvikles.

Grain & Protein Technologies er en global koncern, som danske Cimbria er en del af. Og det er netop hos Cimbria, du får dit fysiske kontor og din daglige gang.

IT-miljøet er globalt med brugere og kolleger på tværs af blandt andet Europa, USA, APAC og Sydamerika.

Derfor er det også vigtigt, at du er komfortabel med at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Du kommer til at arbejde med

  • Microsoft 365 – Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint og OneDrive

  • Entra ID, Azure og Intune

  • Conditional Access, Defender og Identity Protection

  • Brugere, rettigheder, licenser og policies

  • Governance, standarder og i tæt samarbejde med compliance-teamet

  • L2- og L3-support

  • Fejlfinding og problemløsning på tværs af M365 og den øvrige IT-infrastruktur

  • Automatisering og løbende forbedringer af måden, man arbejder på

Derudover vil du få berøring med blandt andet Windows Server, hosting, netværk og disaster recovery.


Lidt om dig
Det er et krav, at du har solid erfaring med Microsoft 365-administration og L2/L3-support.

Du er vant til at arbejde i en større organisation med mange brugere, gerne 500+, og tage ansvar for, at tingene fungerer på tværs.

Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved alt på listen. Til gengæld skal du være teknisk stærk, kunne se sammenhænge, tage beslutninger og ejerskab - og have erfaring nok til at finde årsagen, når noget ikke fungerer, som det skal.

Og så skal du kunne samarbejde med både teknikere, brugere og kolleger, der ikke nødvendigvis synes, at tekniske specifikationer er verdens mest spændende samtaleemne.


Bliv en del af en varm og veletableret afdeling
Du refererer direkte til den ansvarlige leder Jesper Frost. Han hører hjemme på kontoret i Thisted og supporterer over hele EMEA. I den danske IT-afdeling har du et dygtigt, fagligt fællesskab, og I er en del af et globalt hold på +50 kolleger.

Du står altså ikke alene, men du skal vide, at det her er en rolle for dig, der er helt komfortabel med at have ansvar.

Der er en uformel og lattermild tone på kontoret og et naturligt fokus på både personlig og professionel udvikling. Du vil opleve, at flere kollegaer har lang anciennitet i virksomheden.

Det er en fordel, hvis du bor, så du kan komme på kontoret i Thisted eller Herning mandag til torsdag og arbejde hjemme fredag. Men vi ved godt, at du ikke nødvendigvis bor lige rundt om hjørnet, så der kan være mulighed for mere fleksibilitet.


Ærlig talt
Det her er ikke jobbet for dig, hvis du leder efter et IT-miljø, hvor alt allerede er perfekt dokumenteret, standardiseret og sat i system. For det er det ikke. Det er globalt, og det er komplekst.

Men hvis du kan se forbedringsmuligheder og har erfaringen til at føre dem ud i livet, så vil vi rigtig gerne snakke med dig.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Del gerne dit CV eller din LinkedIn-profil og svar på to spørgsmål. Har du noget, der skal afklares først, kan du altid ringe til Hanne Munk på 35 95 35 84.

Vi holder løbende samtaler med ønske om en hurtig proces, hvilket også betyder, at vi tager jobopslaget ned, når vi har rette kandidater i dialog.

Are you the WAITER-CLEANER we are looking for?

Snowhotel Family is a family-owned business in Lehtojärvi, Rovaniemi, offering unique experiences in snow and ice. Arctic Snow Hotel & Glass Igloos with its restaurants guarantee a memorable overnight experience by the shores of Lehtojärvi, surrounded by the Northern Lights and nature. Located in Santa Claus Village, Snowman World invites the whole family to winter fun at a snowy playground made of snow and ice. In Santa Claus Village also locates charming gingerbread houses of Piparina and a cozy restaurant where customers can savor authentic Lapland flavors and relax in private gingerbread cottages throughout the day.

We are now seeking waiter-housekeepers for the busy Christmas Season of 2026–2027 at the Arctic Snow Hotel in Lehtojärvi. Lehtojärvi is located about 25 kilometers from the center of Rovaniemi. The area has five restaurants; at the Ice Restaurant and Ice Bar, drinks are served in dishes made of ice in a stunning environment, not forgetting local delicacies. Breakfast and dinner are served in the Snow Castle, which is the main building. The Hut Restaurant features a flickering fire at its center, where salmon is grilled with delicious side dishes, as well as offering à la carte dishes. In the Sky Bar, guests can sip various drinks while comfortably watching the Northern Lights through the ceiling windows on the upper floor.

As a waiter, your responsibilities will include both plated and buffet service, bar service, recommending food and drinks, and ensuring customer satisfaction with your valuable contributions. The waiter position also includes cleaning tasks in the hotel area. In the housekeeping roles, you will work as part of a cleaning team, ensuring attractive and clean accommodation units and public areas.

Full-time work (112.5 hours/3 weeks) is available from the end of November until 6.1.2027. Part-time work is also possible according to your availability! We follow the collective agreement for the tourism and restaurant industry, and the salary is based on skills and experience. The employment relationship will be established between Bondata and the employee, and accommodation in Lehtojärvi can be arranged if needed.



We offer you:

- A diverse job in the best workplace in Lapland

- A good orientation to your tasks

- Competitive salary

- Shared accommodation for a reasonable rent

We expect from you:

- Experience or education relevant to waiter duties

- Proficiency in English, as our workplace and customers are international

- A hygiene passport or willingness to obtain one at the start of employment

- A positive and proactive work attitude as well as teamwork skills

If you are interested in the position, please send us your CV and application as soon as possible! We will start interviews during the application period.

We are a Great Place to Work certified workplace and ranked 4th in the category of medium-sized companies on the list of the best workplaces in Finland in 2026. RenTid er en professionel rengøringsvirksomhed i Aarhus, hvor kvalitet, grundighed og professionalisme er kernen i alt, hvad vi laver. Vi leverer rengøring ud over det sædvanlige, og derfor søger vi medarbejdere, der deler vores høje standarder.

  • Mulighed for flere timer og på sigt en fuldtidsstilling

  • Attraktiv løn, der afspejler vores høje standarder og forventninger

  • En virksomhed i vækst, hvor dygtige, stabile og engagerede medarbejdere bliver værdsat

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med professionel rengøring – dette er et krav

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljerne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som effektivt i et team

  • Er stabil, pålidelig og møder til tiden

jobs.title: Automation Control and Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Automation Control and Commissioning Manager to work for a 1 year project in Kotka starting from 8.10.2026 and ending on 7.10.2027

Job Description

1\. Responsible for on-site debugging of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) program for the post-processing system and configuration of the upper computer system.

2\. Responsible for data integration and communication protocol matching between the control system provided by the vendor side and the factory level DCS (Distributed Control System) in Finland.

3\. Guide the wiring inspection and signal testing of on-site sensors, actuators, and electrical cabinets to ensure control accuracy.

4\. Responsible for optimizing the fully automated operation logic and adjusting control algorithms based on the characteristics of local raw materials in Finland.

5\. Provide specialized training for local operators in Finland on system operation, fault diagnosis, and maintenance.

6\. Cooperate with the EU CE certification body to conduct on-site electrical safety and functional safety assessments.

Requirements

1.Proficient in mainstream PLC programming such as Siemens and Rockwell, as well as WinCC configuration software.

2\. Proficient in industrial field bus protocols such as Profibus, Profinet, and EtherCAT, with a fundamental understanding of industrial network security.

3\. Possess 3 to 5 years of experience in automation debugging within the chemical or lithium battery materials industry, capable of independently resolving complex communication failures.

4\. Master the source code and debugging passwords of the proprietary control logic for this project, serving as a core member in the development of the metering system control program.

jobs.title: Group Controller
jobs.description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.

We deliver digital solutions for public tenders and procurement across Europe and have built a large, subscription-based business with a strong Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) foundation. Headquartered in Oslo, Mercell is backed by Thoma Bravo, one of the world's leading software and technology investors.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to transform public procurement by making it more accessible and effortless for everyone involved. We envision a world where public buyers and suppliers work seamlessly together to make “a great deal easier” and help shape the future.

Our culture is built on continuous growth, trust and collaboration. We offer an international environment where talented people can thrive alongside ambitious colleagues who are passionate about creating value for our customers and shareholders.


Your Mission 

As Group Controller, you will join our Group Finance team in a broad, hands-on role spanning financial controlling, FP&A and finance operations. Your work will cover areas such as cost controlling, reporting, forecasting, cash management and working capital.

You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and the business, taking ownership and contributing where needed. This is an opportunity to build on your accounting or audit experience, broaden your operational understanding and grow across several areas of finance.


Core Responsibilities  

  • Contribute to financial reporting, analysis and controls, ensuring reliable numbers and useful insights.

  • Support cost controlling, budgeting and forecasting in certain areas in close dialogue with the business.

  • Support with cash management, cash forecasting and working capital to support day-to-day financial operations.

  • Contribute to effective operations around transfer pricing and inter-company financing; internal cost allocation, internal funding and other financial management on legal entity level

  • Improve processes and ways of working, combining attention to detail with a practical, hands-on approach.


Required Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or similar.

  • Strong experience (ideally a minimum of 3-5 years) in accounting, auditing or financial or business controlling, with a solid understanding of financial reporting and analysis. Big4 background is an advantage.

  • An interest in moving closer to the business and developing broader experience in financial reporting and operations.

  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems and data. Experience with Oracle Netsuite is an advantage.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across teams.


Preferred Qualifications  

  • You are curious, structured and enjoy getting things done. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, ask questions and are keen to understand how the numbers connect to everyday operations.

  • You enjoy variety and working in a small team where colleagues support each other. You bring a sound technical foundation and a willingness to learn; experience across every part of the role is not expected. Cash management and other operational finance activities offer opportunities to develop as you grow in the role.

  • You are proactive and thrive in a fast- paced environment where we set ambitious goals and continuously improve how we work

  • You have high professional standards.

 

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Full time

Workplace type: Hybrid - working onsite at the office min. 3 days and from home, balancing flexibility with collaboration

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

Mercell offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of a leading European SaaS company backed by one of the world's foremost technology investors.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Jyväskylään
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Analyst (Commercial Projects & Financial Analysis), Uusimaa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Relevant experience in analyst roles from Investment Banking, Big 4 (Transaction Services / Corporate Finance) or similar advisory role
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Please note that a security clearance will be conducted for the chosen candidate, and any offer of employment is conditional upon a successful security clearance check.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, Prisma Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
IISALMI

Haemme apulaispäällikköä Iisalmen Prismaan
Kiinnostaako sinua käytännönläheinen apulaispäällikön tehtävä käyttötavarakaupan arjessa? Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan osaston päivittäistä tekemistä, hyvää asiakaskokemusta ja tiimin onnistumista yhdessä päällikön kanssa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

Prisma Iisalmi palvelee asiakkaita monipuolisesti arjen ostoksissa ja käyttötavaroissa. Käyttötavaraosastolla onnistuminen syntyy hyvästä asiakaspalvelusta, houkuttelevista esillepanoista, sujuvasta tekemisestä ja hyvästä yhteistyöstä.

Apulaispäällikkönä toimit päällikön tukena käyttötavaraosaston päivittäisessä johtamisessa. Varmistat osaltasi, että asiakaspalvelu, hyllyt, esillepanot ja myynnillinen tekeminen toimivat arjessa sujuvasti. Työhösi kuuluu myös käytännön tekemistä osastolla, tiimin perehdyttämistä, ohjaamista ja valmentamista, palautteen antamista sekä tavoitteiden seuraamista ja toiminnan kehittämistä. Toimit aktiivisena viestijänä tiimin, vuorojen ja päällikön välillä sekä päällikön sijaisena tämän poissa ollessa. Näin viet PeeÄssän arvoja ja Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa -tavoitetta käytäntöön hyvän asiakaskokemuksen ja tiimin onnistumisen kautta.

Tämä tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sinulla on:
- valmius tehdä töitä eri kellonaikoihin asiakasvirtojen mukaan, myös juhlapyhinä
- toimeenpanokykyä, rohkeutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta
- kokemusta vähittäis- ja käyttötavarakaupasta – S-ryhmän järjestelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
- kiinnostusta myynnilliseen tekemiseen, arjen sujuvoittamiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen
- sujuva suomen kielen taito, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä halua innostaa, ohjata ja tehdä yhteistyötä tiimin kanssa
- aktiivista otetta oman osaamisen ja yksikön toiminnan kehittämiseen
- halua toimia arvojemme #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä mukaisesti sekä viedä asiakaslupauksiamme käytäntöön arjen tekemisessä.

Miksi hakea tätä tehtävää?
- pääset tekemään monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä työtä Iisalmen Prisman käyttötavaraosastolla
- työssä yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu, myynnillinen tekeminen, esillepanot ja osaston päivittäinen sujuvuus
- saat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, jossa oma kädenjälkesi näkyy asiakkaiden arjessa ja tiimin onnistumisessa
- saat tueksesi päällikön, tiimin ja selkeät toimintamallit, joiden avulla pääset hyvin kiinni apulaispäällikön tehtävään
- käytössäsi ovat monipuoliset, koko Suomen kattavat henkilöstöedut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut. Voit tutustua PeeÄssän henkilöstöetuihin tarkemmin tästä.

Palkkaus
Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy Kaupan työehtosopimuksen C-palkkaluokan mukaan. Palkka on aiemmasta työkokemuksesta riippuen 2 233–2 572 €/kk. Tehtävässä maksetaan myös TES:n mukaiset lisät toteutuneiden työtuntien mukaan.

Tämän lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus ansaita vuosittaista tulospalkkaa Osuuskauppa PeeÄssässä kulloinkin voimassa olevan tulospalkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta - ja välillä juhlastakin - vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään!

Hakuaikaa on 4.10.2026 saakka, mutta laitathan hakemuksesi tulemaan jo hyvissä ajoin. Aloitamme haastattelut hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Prisma Iisalmen palvelu- ja myyntipäällikkö Asta Kalanti, asta.kalanti@sok.fi, puh. 044 719 7305 arkisin klo 8–16.

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, NDF, Helsinki
jobs.description:
The Nordic Development Fund (NDF) is the joint Nordic international finance institution, established by Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden. NDFs work focuses on the nexus between climate change and development in lower-income countries and countries in fragile situations. Together with our strategic partners, we develop, launch and scale high-impact projects to support developing countries and people vulnerable to climate change.

To support smooth daily operations, effective leadership and strong internal and external collaboration, NDF is now recruiting an Executive Assistant to join the Managing Directors Office at NDF. This is a fixed-term position for one year to cover a period of parental leave. The preferred start date is mid-October 2026.

The Executive Assistant will provide high-quality administrative and coordination support to the Managing Director and selected department directors. The role reports to the Managing Director and is central to effective information flow, well-organised leadership support, travel coordination, internal collaboration and a professional working environment across NDF.

Key responsibilities

Provide executive administrative support to the Managing Director and selected department directors, including calendar coordination, correspondence, document preparation, inquiry handling, information flow and filing.

Coordinate travel and related logistics, including travel arrangements, itineraries, visas, travel-related invoices and expenses in line with organisational procedures.

Serve as NDFs travel focal point, including guidance on travel procedures and approvals, maintenance of travel guidance, compliance monitoring and support to travel safety and emergency response as a member of the ISOS Response Group.

Support departmental and organisational coordination, including agreed administrative support to department directors, internal information sharing, planning and coordination of Executive Management Committee (EMC) meetings, and serving as focal point for induction of new staff members.

Plan and coordinate internal and external meetings and events, including logistics for staff meetings and other recurring activities.

Support internal development initiatives and effective use of digital tools.

Contribute to a positive and professional working environment by acting with integrity, flexibility, discretion and a service-oriented mindset, and by carrying out other relevant duties as requested.

Key competencies, experience and personal attributes

A genuine interest in [NDFs purpose and values](https://www.ndf.int/who-we-are/about-us/purpose-and-values.html), and motivation to contribute to NDFs mandate in climate and development finance.

Relevant administrative, business or other applicable professional education.

Several years of relevant experience in an executive assistant or similar administrative role, preferably in an international or multicultural working environment.

Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to work independently, take initiative and manage competing priorities.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proactive, solution-oriented and collaborative working style.

High level of discretion, integrity and professionalism, including the ability to handle sensitive information appropriately.

Advanced MS Office skills and readiness to learn and use other relevant digital tools and platforms.

Fluency in English, both written and oral. Working proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage, and other language skills are considered an asset.

We offer you

The opportunity to work in an international organisation in the field of climate change and development finance.

Varied and meaningful work in a multicultural and multilingual environment.

A role close to NDFs leadership and organisational coordination, with broad exposure to NDFs work and stakeholders.

An opportunity for a hybrid working model and other attractive employee benefits.

Application instructions and further information:

The selected candidate will be employed directly by NDF.

Register as an applicant and complete the application form carefully, and attach your CV to your application. In your application, please highlight how your strengths support the different aspects and focus areas of the role.

NDFs work focuses on the nexus between climate change and development in lower-income countries and countries in fragile situations. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution
Job ID: 10530871 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within World Wide Operations Security WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

- Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
- Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
- Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
- Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

- Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
- Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
- Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
- Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
- Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

- Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
- Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
- Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
- Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
- Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
- Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
- Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Data & Analytics Stewardship

- Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
- Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
- Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
- Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to collaborate and lead in a flexible, detail-oriented, fast-paced team environment
- Demonstrated ability to independently use AI tools in daily work, integrating them into program workflows to drive better outcomes, and guiding others on effective adoption

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification
- Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
- ISO 28000 (Supply Chain Security Management System) or TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association) certification
- Experience with supply chain security frameworks (ASIS, AIBM-CSCRM)

jobs.title: Solution Architect I - Subsidy Projects (fixed-term 24 months) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner.
The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services.
Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn


Purpose of the job / project

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.
You will work on one or more projects from that portfolio — currently including STORE-1PLUSMG, USE-1PLUSMG, SCAILED, the European Compliance Stack, DDSSC2, COOPAIFA and PANDAI — with assignments set by portfolio priorities and evolving as projects start and close.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values.
We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact.
Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative.
Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.
